info.title: Yapin’ Bot API
info.description: Drive a Yapin’ bot account over HTTPS. Send `Authorization: Bot <token>` (Settings → Developer). JSON in, JSON out. Pictures (avatar_path, banner_path, icon_path, attachment_path) are paths: the link is https://files.yapper.website/<bucket>/<path> (buckets avatars, banners, icons, attachments). Events come over the gateway (wss://rt.yapper.website/bot), the long poll (GET /events) or your webhook: see webhooks and x-gateway. Every answer carries X-Yapin-API-Version (this document's version) and X-Yapin-Build (short commit of the build). Docs: https://www.yapin.gg/developers

requestBody.description: JSON, or multipart/form-data (flag bot_uploads) to send files: the same body as JSON text in "payload_json" and up to 4 files in "files[0]"... ("file" works for one), up to 10 MB each and 12 MB in all. Each file becomes its own message (the first one carries the text, embeds, buttons and reply), checked like a person’s upload before it shows. Pictures (PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP), videos (MP4, WebM, MOV), sounds (MP3, OGG, WAV, M4A, up to a minute) and TXT, PDF or ZIP files. A name starting with SPOILER_ hides a picture until clicked. Content can be empty. Needs Attach Files. 20 files a minute per bot.

x-files.note: Each file becomes its own message (the first one carries the text, embeds, buttons and reply), checked like a person’s upload before it shows. Content can be empty. Needs Attach Files. 20 files a minute per bot
